quarterly_data.quarter: Lam Research press release: Lam Research Announces Plans to Invest More than $3B to (08-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Lam intends to invest more than $3 billion over the next five years to expand its global R&D lab network (United States, Asia and Europe); the multi-site expansion is expected to increase experiment capacity by more than 50%, and Lam plans to begin expanding this year. The combined lab infrastructure supports more than one million experiments annually, and in recent customer engagements the integrated lab approach shortened process development up to 2.5 times. CEO Tim Archer: 'We are investing with the intention of staying ahead of what our customers need.'
quarterly_data.figure: more than $3 billion over five years; experiment capacity up more than 50%; more than one million experiments annually; process development up to 2.5 times shorter
